Excel workbook generation failed due to broken lookup formulas resulting in #N/A errors across multiple data blocks.
The test_legacy_pytest_suite failed with multiple AssertionErrors in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned #N/A instead of expected numeric values like 155.4 or -2.047. This indicates that the VLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH formulas implemented in the 'Task' sheet are failing to resolve against the source data, likely due to incorrect range references or mismatched lookup keys.
